# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.5 Subject System & 24 Overlord Deep Interactions (Slot 69, oe_sub_). Generated by gen_subject_interactions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 17. Enfeoff Marshal to Frontier Subject (敕封名将出镇边藩)
oe_sub_enfeoff_general_to_subject = {
    message = yes
    on_own_nation = yes
    ai_tick = never
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { at_war = no }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = character
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_character"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            is_alive = yes
            is_adult = yes
            is_ruler = no
            is_heir = no
            is_consort = no
            is_regent = no
            mil >= 65
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_sub_choose_subject"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_sub_no_eligible_subject"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
            OR = {
                is_subject_type = oe_sub_foederati
                is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu
                is_subject_type = vassal
                is_subject_type = march
            }
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_enfeoff_gen_cd } }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
            scope:actor = { oe_sub_bump_act = yes }
            scope:recipient = {
                move_country = scope:target
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_frontier_marshal_char years = 15 mode = replace }
            }
            scope:target = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_famous_general_garrison years = 15 mode = replace }
                add_liberty_desire = -15
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_general_enfeoffed }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_enfeoff_gen_cd years = 15 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

# 18. Dispatch Imperial Prince-Viceroy (遣宗王子弟出镇监国)
oe_sub_dispatch_prince_viceroy = {
    message = yes
    on_own_nation = yes
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 36
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            government_type = government_type:monarchy
            has_ruler = yes
            ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            gold >= 100
            prestige >= 10
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = character
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_character"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            is_alive = yes
            is_adult = yes
            is_ruler = no
            is_heir = no
            is_consort = no
            is_regent = no
            has_dynasty = yes
            dynasty ?= scope:actor.ruler.dynasty
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_sub_choose_subject"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_sub_no_eligible_subject"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_prince_viceroy_cd } }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -100
                add_prestige = -10
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_viceroy_sub value = scope:target }
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                move_country = scope:target
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_viceroy_char years = 20 mode = replace }
            }
            scope:target = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_dynastic_regency years = 20 mode = replace }
                add_liberty_desire = -20
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_prince_viceroy }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_prince_viceroy_cd years = 20 }
            }
            scope:actor = {
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sub.50
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -50
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = {
                    gold >= 400
                    ruler ?= { dynasty ?= { num_adult_available_dynasty_members >= 4 } }
                }
                scope:target ?= { liberty_desire >= 35 }
            }
            add = 65
        }
    }
}

# 19. Summon Vassal Heir to Court (征召附庸世子入京质宿)
oe_sub_summon_subject_heir_hostage = {
    message = yes
    on_own_nation = no
    on_other_nation = yes
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { at_war = no }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = character
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = {
                every_subject = {
                    limit = { country_type = location }
                    every_character = {
                        limit = {
                            is_alive = yes
                            is_ruler = no
                            NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char }
                            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
                        }
                        add_to_list = source
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_character"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            is_alive = yes
            owner != scope:actor
            owner ?= { is_subject_of = scope:actor country_type = location }
            is_ruler = no
            NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char }
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
            OR = {
                is_heir = yes
                AND = {
                    has_dynasty = yes
                    owner ?= { has_ruler = yes ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes } }
                    dynasty ?= owner.ruler.dynasty
                }
            }
        }
        enabled = {
            owner ?= {
                custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_hostage_cd } }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:recipient.owner = { save_scope_as = oe_sub_home_sub }
            scope:actor = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_has_ward value = 1 }
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_hostage_home value = scope:oe_sub_home_sub }
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_hostage_overlord value = scope:actor }
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_hostage_return_m value = oe_sub_m_plus60 }
                move_country = scope:actor
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char years = 5 mode = replace }
            }
            scope:oe_sub_home_sub = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_heir_at_imperial_court years = 5 mode = replace }
                add_liberty_desire = -18
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_heir_hostage }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_hostage_cd years = 15 }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -35
        if = {
            limit = { scope:recipient ?= { owner ?= { liberty_desire >= 35 } } }
            add = 55
        }
    }
}

# 20. Confer Imperial Vassal Dignity (册封附庸君主帝国荣衔)
oe_sub_grant_imperial_title_to_vassal = {
    message = yes
    on_own_nation = no
    on_other_nation = yes
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            gold >= 80
            prestige >= 3
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = character
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = {
                every_subject = {
                    limit = { country_type = location has_ruler = yes }
                    ruler ?= { add_to_list = source }
                }
            }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_character"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            is_alive = yes
            is_ruler = yes
            owner != scope:actor
            owner ?= { is_subject_of = scope:actor country_type = location }
            NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_sub_imperial_honor_title_char }
        }
        enabled = {
            owner ?= {
                custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_honor_title_cd } }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -80
                add_prestige = -3
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_overlord_honor_prestige years = 10 mode = replace }
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_honor_title_char years = -1 mode = replace }
                owner = {
                    add_liberty_desire = -15
                    add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_imperial_title }
                    add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_honor_title_cd years = 12 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -15
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { gold >= 250 }
                scope:recipient ?= { owner ?= { liberty_desire >= 20 } }
            }
            add = 45
        }
    }
}

            is_regent = no
            adm >= 60
            NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_sub_resident_commission_char }

    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country

        target_flag = target

        none_available_msg_key = "oe_sub_no_eligible_subject"

            country_type = location

            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_resident_cd } }
            liberty_desire < 55

        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }

            }
            add = 45
        }
    }
}

# 22. Patronize Subject Noble at Academy (拔擢附庸俊彦入御前书院)
oe_sub_educate_subject_noble_at_court = {
    message = yes
    on_own_nation = no
    on_other_nation = yes
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            any_subject = { country_type = location }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { gold >= 60 }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = character
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = {
                every_subject = {
                    limit = { country_type = location }
                    every_character = {
                        limit = {
                            is_alive = yes
                            is_ruler = no
                            age_in_years < 35
                            NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_sub_imperial_academy_grad_char }
                            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
                        }
                        add_to_list = source
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_character"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            is_alive = yes
            owner != scope:actor
            owner ?= { is_subject_of = scope:actor country_type = location }
            is_ruler = no
            age_in_years < 35
            NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_sub_imperial_academy_grad_char }
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
        }
        enabled = {
            owner ?= {
                custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_educate_cd } }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -60
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_adm = 5
                add_dip = 5
                add_mil = 5
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_academy_grad_char years = -1 mode = replace }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { culture = scope:actor.culture } }
                    random = {
                        chance = 65
                        change_character_culture = scope:actor.culture
                    }
                }
                owner = {
                    add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_academy_patronage }
                    add_liberty_desire = -6
                    add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_educate_cd years = 10 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -25
        if = {
            limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 350 } }
            add = 40
        }
    }
}

# 23. Recall Disloyal Vassal Minister (槛车押回跋扈藩镇权臣)
oe_sub_recall_disloyal_governor = {
    message = yes
    on_own_nation = no
    on_other_nation = yes
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 12
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            any_subject = {
                country_type = location
                OR = { subject_loyalty < 45 liberty_desire >= 45 }
            }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { prestige >= 10 }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = character
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = {
                every_subject = {
                    limit = {
                        country_type = location
                        OR = { subject_loyalty < 45 liberty_desire >= 45 }
                    }
                    every_character = {
                        limit = {
                            is_alive = yes
                            is_adult = yes
                            is_ruler = no
                            is_heir = no
                            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
                        }
                        add_to_list = source
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_character"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            is_alive = yes
            is_adult = yes
            is_ruler = no
            is_heir = no
            owner != scope:actor
            owner ?= {
                is_subject_of = scope:actor
                country_type = location
                OR = { subject_loyalty < 45 liberty_desire >= 45 }
            }
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
        }
        enabled = {
            owner ?= {
                custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_recall_gov_cd } }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = {
                add_prestige = -10
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient.owner = {
                add_stability = -5
                add_liberty_desire = -15
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_governor_recalled }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_recall_gov_cd years = 15 }
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                move_country = scope:actor
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_house_arrest_char years = 10 mode = replace }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -40
        if = {
            limit = { scope:recipient ?= { owner ?= { liberty_desire > 55 } } }
            add = 65
        }
    }
}

# 24. Sponsor Dynastic Marriage Pact (赐婚缔结宗藩姻盟)
oe_sub_sponsor_dynastic_marriage_pact = {
    message = yes
    on_own_nation = yes
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 24
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            government_type = government_type:monarchy
            has_ruler = yes
            ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
            any_subject = { country_type = location government_type = government_type:monarchy }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { gold >= 100 }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = character
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_character"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            is_alive = yes
            is_adult = yes
            is_ruler = no
            is_heir = no
            is_consort = no
            is_regent = no
            is_married = no
            is_eligible_for_marriage = yes
            has_dynasty = yes
            dynasty ?= scope:actor.ruler.dynasty
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_sub_choose_subject"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_sub_no_eligible_subject"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            country_type = location
            government_type = government_type:monarchy
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_sub_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_sub_marriage_pact_cd } }
            has_ruler = yes
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -100
                oe_sub_bump_act = yes
            }
            scope:recipient = {
                move_country = scope:target
            }
            scope:target = {
                if = {
                    limit = { ruler ?= { is_married = no can_marry_character = scope:recipient } }
                    ruler = { marry_character = scope:recipient }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { any_character = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes is_married = no can_marry_character = scope:recipient } }
                    random_character = {
                        limit = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes is_married = no can_marry_character = scope:recipient }
                        marry_character = scope:recipient
                    }
                }
                add_liberty_desire = -20
                add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_sub_b_dynastic_marriage }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_dynastic_marriage_bond years = 20 mode = replace }
                add_cooldown = { type = oe_sub_marriage_pact_cd years = 15 }
            }
            scope:actor = {
                add_opinion = { target = scope:target modifier = oe_sub_b_dynastic_marriage }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = -30
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { gold >= 300 }
                scope:target ?= { liberty_desire >= 25 }
            }
            add = 50
        }
    }
}
